'''Serooin's Gear''' was a shop located on the West Cliff of [[Betha II Starport]] on the smuggler's planet [[Betha II]]. The establishment was owned and operated by a [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] infochant named [[Arrejis Mellaha]]. Serooin's specialized in both legal and illegal personal gear, which it offered at 20% higher than the going rate.<ref name="CS" />

When an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] faction known as the [[Restored Empire|Kaarenth Dissension]] began sowing anti-Human and anti-[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] feeling among the aliens of the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Mellaha grew paranoid. He greeted visitors to his shop with a short temper and a hidden blaster. He began to liquidate Serooin's stock so he could relocate to a safer location.<ref name="CS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Serooin's Gear is the site of a brief encounter during the roleplaying adventure "[[Counterstrike (Adventure Journal)|Counterstrike]]" for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 8]]. The shop serves as a place from which the player characters may resupply before they undertake their mission. "Counterstrike" was reprinted in ''[[Classic Adventures: Volume Four — The Best of the Journal]]''.
